Package com.impinj.octane

Class AutoStartConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.impinj.octane.AutoStartConfig
  • public class AutoStartConfig
extends java.lang.Object
    The ImpinjReader can be configured to start inventory automatically based on several inputs including General purpose input (GPI) and time. This class holds the configuration for the Auto start feature.

      • getUtcTimestamp

        public long getUtcTimestamp()
        Get the UTC timestamp that establishes the zero time for autostart periodic mode timers. If a UTC time is specified, then the first start time is determined as (UTC time + offset). Otherwise, the first start time is determined as (time of message receipt + offset). Subsequent start times = first start time + k * period (where, k greater than 0)
        Returns:
        the UTC timestamp

      • setUtcTimestamp

        public void setUtcTimestamp​(long utcTimestamp)
        Set the UTC timestamp that establishes the zero time for autostart periodic mode timers. If a UTC time is specified, then the first start time is determined as (UTC time + offset). Otherwise, the first start time is determined as (time of message receipt + offset). Subsequent start times = first start time + k * period (where, k greater than 0)
        Parameters:
        utcTimestamp - the UTC timestamp to set.
